text: DONUTCHART CAN PRINT AMOUNTS, BESIDE THE RING. Two optional props on the segmented DonutChart: `legendValue="value"` prints each slice's figure through `valueFormat` ("₹46,676 Cr") instead of its share, and `layout="side"` sets the legend beside the ring with the values right-aligned, stacking below 768px. Both default to the previous behaviour. Added for the website's Beneficiary Dashboard, whose Share of Fund Release ring lists nine schemes by amount; story: Part-to-Whole Charts › Donut With Amounts Beside.
